notes: Most graduate application guidelines (eligibility, English scores) are PDFs, which the snapshot tool does not turn into text, so they could not be quoted; only values on HTML pages are recorded. Dates on several pages are for past 2026 intakes and were not recorded. Japanese-taught master's courses were not reached.

programs.name: International Graduate Program for Advanced Science (IGPAS), Master's Program

academic.text: Master's: completed (or will complete) 16 years of education by 30 September 2027
academic.quote: Those who have completed (or will complete) 16 years of education by September 30, 2027.

prerequisites.text: Written consent of a prospective supervisor in the Graduate School of Science is required before applying
prerequisites.quote: Applications will not be accepted without the consent of a faculty member as a prospective supervisor.

prerequisites.text: Astronomy applicants must submit a GRE Subject Test score in Physics
prerequisites.quote: For Astronomy Applicants The GRE® subject test score in Physics is mandatory to submit upon application.

prerequisites.text: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit an English proficiency test score (any suitable test, not only TOEFL or IELTS)
prerequisites.quote: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit the score of an English proficiency test. However, it does not have to be a TOEFL® or IELTS score.

prerequisites.text: No minimum English score is set; English is judged from all documents and the interview
prerequisites.quote: We do not have particular score requirements.

programs.name: International Course of Life Sciences (ICLS), Master's Program

academic.text: Generally a bachelor's degree with 16 years of formal education is required; equivalent foreign degrees need an equivalent number of years
academic.quote: Generally, a Japanese bachelor's degree (16 years of formal education (university degree) before entering graduate school) is required.

prerequisites.text: Submission of an English score (TOEIC L&R, TOEFL iBT, IELTS or Duolingo English Test) is mandatory
prerequisites.quote: English Proficiency Score Requirements: Submission of a score from TOEIC® L&R, TOEFL iBT®, IELTS, or Duolingo English Test is mandatory.

prerequisites.text: A copy of the prospective supervisor's agreement to accept the applicant is required
prerequisites.quote: Faculty Consent: You are required to submit a copy of an email or document confirming that your prospective supervisor has agreed to let you join their lab.

programs.name: International Environmental Security Leadership Program (IESLP), Master's Program

academic.text: Master's: graduated (or will graduate) from a university by 30 September 2027
academic.quote: Those who have graduated, or will graduate, from a university (see note [1]) by September 30, 2027.

prerequisites.text: Consent of at least one prospective supervisor in the Graduate School of Environmental Studies is required
prerequisites.quote: Applications will not be accepted without the consent of at least one faculty member as a prospective supervisor.

prerequisites.text: A valid official English test score report (TOEFL iBT, TOEIC or IELTS, four skills) is required; MEXT scholarship candidates need CEFR B2 equivalent
prerequisites.quote: For MEXT scholarship applicant, your English test score should be equivalent to B2-level of CEFR.

programs.name: Global Program in Economics and Management (GPEM), Master's Program

academic.text: Open to anyone who has completed any undergraduate degree
academic.quote: Yes, the GPEM programme is open to anyone who has completed any undergraduate degree.

prerequisites.text: TOEFL or IELTS score required unless graduated from a university in a country where English is the native language
prerequisites.quote: Yes –unless you have graduated from a university located in a country where English is the native language.

prerequisites.text: Programme starts in October every year; no entrance exam, applications are reviewed by the university
prerequisites.quote: No, the GPEM program begins in October every year.

programs.name: International Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering Course (IMAC-G), Master's Program

deadlines.label: October 2027 enrollment (Feb. and March admission)
deadlines.quote: Application Submission Period: 9:00 on January 6 to 16:00 on January 14, 2027 (Japan Time)

programs.name: International Materials Science and Engineering Course (IMSE), Master's Program

deadlines.label: October 2027 enrollment
deadlines.quote: Submission of Applications, from January 6 to January 14, 2027

deadlines.label: October 2027 enrollment
deadlines.quote: Submission of Applications, from November 18 to 26, 2026

deadlines.label: October 2027 enrollment
deadlines.quote: Submission of Applications, from November 18 to 26, 2026

programs.name: Graduate School of Biomedical Engineering, Two-Year Master's Program (international students)

academic.text: International student with sixteen years of formal education, or recognised as equal or superior to a Japanese university graduate
academic.quote: An international student who has completed sixteen years of formal education, or who is recognized to be equal or superior in scholastic achievements to a graduate from a Japanese university may apply for admission to this course.

prerequisites.text: English is not tested at the exam; it is evaluated from TOEFL iBT or TOEIC scores (ITP/IP not accepted)
prerequisites.quote: English language testing is not part of the entrance exam for our graduate school, instead English language ability will be evaluated on the results of TOEFL®, TOEIC® English language exams.

programs.name: International Graduate Program in Language Sciences (IGPLS), Master's Program

prerequisites.text: Only an official TOEIC L&R Public Test digital certificate (with QR code, taken in Japan) is accepted as TOEIC evidence
prerequisites.quote: In response to reports of fraudulent TOEIC test-taking, for graduate school admissions at the Graduate School of International Cultural Studies, Tohoku University, only the official digital certificate for the TOEIC® Listening & Reading Public Test conducted in Japan will be accepted.

programs.name: Graduate Program in Global Governance and Sustainable Development (G2SD), Master's Program

prerequisites.text: Only an official TOEIC L&R Public Test digital certificate (with QR code, taken in Japan) is accepted as TOEIC evidence
prerequisites.quote: In response to reports of fraudulent TOEIC test-taking, for graduate school admissions at the Graduate School of International Cultural Studies, Tohoku University, only the official digital certificate for the TOEIC® Listening & Reading Public Test conducted in Japan will be accepted.
